evidence: Unanswerable fraction = 20/506 = 3.95%
With batch_size=8, expected unanswerable per micro-batch = 0.32
68% of micro-batches contain ZERO unanswerable examples
CLS gradient is diluted by 96% answerable signal
Model never learns strong CLS preference
CLS avg logit = 0.617 but max non-CLS logit = 1.0-2.3
root_causes.what_to_test: Increase unanswerable ratio to 25-50% and retrain

evidence: Model HAS learned some no-answer signal (CLS avg=0.617)
CLS is never the argmax (other tokens have higher logits)
Threshold sweep shows: at threshold=0.5, 13/14 holdout abstained
At threshold=0.6, 6/14 abstained
Current evaluation uses argmax (no threshold)
The no-answer signal exists but is not the strongest logit
root_causes.what_to_test: Add null-score comparison in evaluation (compare CLS score vs best answer score)

evidence: All 20 unanswerable training examples from 'unanswerable_corpus'
Contexts are short (44-95 chars), synthetic, generic
Answerable contexts are long, technical, from real documents
Domain mismatch: unanswerable examples look nothing like answerable
Model may associate unanswerable with context style, not semantics
root_causes.what_to_test: Generate unanswerable examples from the same documents as answerable examples

evidence: Checkpoint selected by val_EM (primary metric)
All 3 epochs had val_abstention=0.0%
Abstention was never a factor in selection
Would not have changed outcome since all epochs had 0% abstention
root_causes.what_to_test: N/A — this is a secondary issue

summary: The F2 experiment failed because (1) the 3.95% unanswerable ratio is too low to produce a strong CLS signal, (2) the evaluation uses argmax which never selects CLS even when some no-answer signal exists, and (3) the unanswerable training examples are out-of-distribution compared to the answerable examples.
next_experiment_recommendation: Test whether increasing unanswerable ratio to ~50% (F3) restores abstention. Separately test whether threshold-based evaluation (comparing CLS score vs best answer score) can recover abstention from the existing F2 model.
